subject: PolarWave CAIQ kickoff and evidence handoff planning
messages:
From: Maya Rios <maya.rios@polarwave.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ kickoff: PolarWave / Redwood Inference — propose Mon 7/5 10am PT

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks for offering to run through the CAIQ with us — we'd like to get a kickoff scheduled so we can map controls to owners on our side and hand off artifacts. Proposed time: Mon Jul 5 at 10:00 AM PT. If that doesn't work, Tue morning also ok.

Pre-call ask from our compliance team: could you share a short checklist of the evidence items you typically need for CAIQ/SIG (logs, configs, certs, system diagrams) and any preferred formats? Also, we want to surface one specific item ahead of the call: CloudTrail samples for the past 7 days and any example log exports for model inference (request traces, ingress/egress). Could you tell us the expected retention windows you require for log samples vs. full exports?

We'll try to gather: CloudTrail, VPC flow logs, a sample of model access audit logs, and a high-level network diagram. I'll be the main point on our side (cc-ing Matt who will join for the technical bits).

Thanks,
Maya Rios
Head of Security Operations
PolarWave Inc.

Date: 2027-06-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff: PolarWave / Redwood Inference — propose Mon 7/5 10am PT

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the attached CAIQ draft. Monday 7/5 at 10am PT works for me; Marissa, David — can you confirm?

Quick answers up front:
- We typically ask for 7–14 days of sample logs for review, plus a plan for full exports (S3 bucket or secure transfer).
- Preferred formats: CloudTrail JSON, VPC flow logs (text/csv), and zipped collections for bulk artifacts.
- For the call, please have one person who can answer questions about logging architecture and another who can share where artifacts will be uploaded.

I'll share a short Redwood evidence checklist prior to the meeting and a link to a template you can drop artifacts into. Also: is this for Redwood Hosted API usage or a Dedicated/Private deployment? That will change some of the evidence we ask for (e.g., host-level config).

Thanks — sending calendar invite now.

Olga Petrov
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rios <maya.rios@polarwave.ai>, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-01T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff: PolarWave / Redwood Inference — prep and evidence checklist

Hi Maya — following up with the prep list so we can hit the ground running.

Agenda (30–45m):
- Quick intros and scope (5m)
- CAIQ control mapping: what you have vs. gaps (15m)
- Evidence handoff plan and storage/permissions (10m)
- Open Q&A and next steps (10m)

Minimum evidence items to upload ahead of the call (or make available during):
- CloudTrail sample (7 days) — JSON exports
- VPC Flow Logs sample (7 days) — text or CSV
- Model inference/access audit sample (request ids, timestamps, user ids)
- IAM policy snapshots for any service accounts used for inference
- High-level network diagram (PDF/PNG)
- KMS key policy excerpt (if using CMK)

Questions to consider on your side (helps speed the call):
1) Do you run inference in Redwood Hosted or Dedicated/Private?
2) Which AWS account(s) hold logs and who will grant read access?
3) Is there a SIEM or log aggregation pipeline we should be aware of?
4) What retention policy is currently applied to CloudTrail and flow logs?

I've attached our evidence matrix template for you to populate: redwood-evidence-template.csv (stub). I'll also post a Drive folder where you can drop items: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPolarWaveCAIQ

If you prefer, we can accept a single zipped bundle via a secure S3 presigned URL.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-evidence-template.csv (csv)
From: Matt Nguyen <matt.nguyen@polarwave.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: maya.rios@polarwave.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T12:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff: PolarWave / Redwood Inference — prep and evidence checklist

Hi Marissa / Olga,

Thanks for the checklist — we can provide everything on the list. Answers to your questions:
- Inference is on our Dedicated deployment (self-hosted in our VPC).
- Logs live in customer-managed AWS accounts; we'll grant read-only access via a cross-account role or provide presigned S3 exports.
- We push logs to a Splunk instance, but we can extract raw CloudTrail/flow logs.
- Retention: CloudTrail full events retained 90 days in hot storage; archived beyond that in Glacier. VPC flow logs retained 30 days.

I've uploaded a small sample bundle to our secure handoff and attached it here for your triage: cloudtrail-sample.tar.gz (attachment stub). Also linking our compliance portal where the CAIQ lives: https://compliance.polarwave.ai/record/PW-CAIQ-2027

We will accept the calendar invite — see you Monday.

Regards,
Matt Nguyen
Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
PolarWave Inc.
